book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: SAN MARCOS Jesucristo yee Añurije Quetire Marcos cʉ̃ ca Owarique

content: O biro ĩi nemoupi ñucã: —Yee méé mʉjare yʉ ĩi: Jĩcãrã ano ca niirã mena macãrã, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca doti niiri tabe, cʉ̃ ca tutuarije mena ca earo ĩatirãra bii yaitirucuma —ĩiupi.
Jesús cʉ̃ ca baurije ca wajoarique
Jĩcã amo peti, ape amore jĩcãga penituaro niiri rʉmʉri jiro, Jesús, cʉ̃ buerã Pedro, Juan, Santiago jãa wadore, ʉ̃tãgʉ ca emʉaricʉpʉ jʉo waaupi. Toopʉ, cʉ̃ja ca ĩa cojoro cʉ̃ ca baurije wajoacoaupi.
Cʉ̃ juti cãa bʉaro boti ajiyaarije biicoaupe. Jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera bʉaro coecã pacagʉ, añuro botiritopʉ cʉ̃ ca tii majitiro ametʉeneropʉ botiupe.
Ñucã Elías, Moisés baua eari, Jesús mena wede peni niiupa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca biiro ĩagʉ, Pedro pea o biro ĩiupi Jesús're: —Buegʉ, anopʉ mani ca niiro añu majuropeecã. Itia wii, wii pĩiri jãa quenorucu. Mʉ yaa wii, Moisés yaa wii, Elías yaa wii, jãa tiirucu —ĩiupi.
Cʉ̃ ca wederijere, “To biirije yʉ ĩicu,” ĩi majiticãupi, niipetirãpʉra ʉcʉa yaicoama ĩirã.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca bii niirora, bueri bʉrʉa doo, cʉ̃jare paa ũmaa nʉcõcãupe. To biro ca biirora bueri bʉrʉapʉ wederique o biro ca ĩirije wedeoupe: “Ania, yʉ Macʉ̃, yʉ ca maigʉ niimi. Cʉ̃re tʉo nʉnʉjeeya,” ĩiupe.
To biro ca ĩiri nimarora ĩa cojorã, Jesús jĩcʉ̃rena ĩaupa.

Ʉ̃tãgʉpʉ ca niiricarã duwi nʉnʉa doorã, Jesús pea: “Mʉja ca ĩajãrijere jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peerena wedeticãña, yʉ, Ca Nii Majuropeegʉ Macʉ̃ ca bii yairicarã watoare yʉ ca cati tuaro jiropʉ mʉja wederucu,” cʉ̃jare ĩiupi.
Tee jʉori, cʉ̃ja wadora atere majicõa niirucuupa, biirãpʉa cʉ̃ja majurope, “Do biro ĩirʉgaro to ĩibuti, ca bii yairicarã watoare cati tuarique,” ameri ĩi jãiña nii pacarã.
To biri o biro cʉ̃re ĩi jãiñaupa: —¿Ñee tiirã doti cũuriquere ca jʉo buerã pea: “Elías doo jʉorucumi,” cʉ̃ja ĩirucuti? —ĩiupa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩi jãiñaro, o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi yʉʉupi Jesús: —Yee méé ĩima, Elías'ra doo jʉgue, cʉ̃ra niipetirijere queno, tiirucumi. To docare, ¿ñee tiiro Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ wederique, “Yʉ, Ca Nii Majuropeegʉ Macʉ̃re, ñañaro tamʉo, ĩa juna eco biirucumi,” ĩi owarique to niiti?
Yʉ pea, “Mee, Elías doo yerijãaupi,” yʉ ĩi. Cʉ̃ja pea niipetiro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca tiirʉgari wãmeri cõro cʉ̃re tiiupa. Cʉ̃re ca biipere to biro tii ecorucumi, cʉ̃ja ca ĩi owa tuuricarore birora —ĩiupi.
Wãmʉ ca wãtĩ jãa ecoricʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca catiorique
Aperã cʉ̃ buerã pʉto peere tua earã, paʉ bojoca watoapʉ nii, ñucã jĩcãrã doti cũuriquere ca jʉo buerã cʉ̃ja mena cʉ̃ja ca wede peni niiro bua eaupa.
Jesús're ĩacãrãpʉa, ʉjea niirique mena cʉ̃re ũmaa boca jãiupa.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca biiro, cʉ̃ pea o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi jãiñaupi: —¿Ñee ʉnore cʉ̃ja mena mʉja wede peniti? —ĩiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, jĩcʉ̃ too cʉ̃ja watoa ca niigʉ, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉupi: —Buegʉ, yʉ macʉ̃re wãtĩ cʉ̃re ñaajãa nʉcã eari, ca wedetigʉ cʉ̃ ca tuaro cʉ̃ ca tiigʉre, mʉ yʉ ami doojãwʉ.

Noo cʉ̃ ca niiri tabe ñaajãa nʉcãri, cʉ̃ ca ñaacũmu yugui mecʉ̃ro tii, cʉ̃ ʉjeropʉ jopo witi, upi baca dʉpo tuu, tutua pʉyʉacoa, cʉ̃ ca biiro cʉ̃re tiimi. Mʉ buerãre, “Wãtĩre cõa wieneña,” cʉ̃jare yʉ ĩimijãwʉ. Do biro tii majitijãwa —ĩiupi.

To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Jesús pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉupi: —¡Agó nija, díámacʉ̃ ca tʉo nʉnʉjeetirã! ¿No cõro yoaro mʉja mena yʉ niigʉti? ¿No cõro yoaro to biro mʉja ca biirijere yʉ nʉcã niigʉti? Ano pee cʉ̃re ami dooya —ĩiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, Jesús pʉto cʉ̃re ami waaupa. Wãtĩ pea Jesús're ĩagʉra, wãmʉ yepapʉ ñaacũmu waa, yugui mecʉ̃, cʉ̃ ʉjeropʉ jopo witi, cʉ̃ ca biiro cʉ̃re tiiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca biiro, Jesús pea o biro ĩi jãiñaupi cʉ̃ pacʉre: —¿No cõropʉ atere to biro cʉ̃ bii jʉori? —cʉ̃re ĩiupi. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro cʉ̃ pacʉ pea: —Wimagʉ niigʉpʉra to biro bii jʉowi.
Paʉ tiiri cʉ̃re jĩarʉgʉ, pecamepʉ tii cõa joe, ñucã diapʉ cʉ̃ ca ñaañuaro cʉ̃re tii, tii mecʉ̃orucumi. No jĩcã wãme ʉno mʉ ca tii majijata, jãare boo paca ĩari, jãare tii nemoña —ĩiupi Jesús're.
To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ ca ĩiro tʉogʉ: —¡Níjá! ¿Ñee tiigʉ mʉ ca tii majijata, mʉ ĩiti? Díámacʉ̃ ca tʉo nʉnʉjeegʉra niipetirije tii majirique wado nii —cʉ̃re ĩiupi Jesús.
To cõrora cʉ̃ pacʉ pea o biro ĩi acaro buiupi: —¡Bʉaro jañuri yʉ ca tʉo nʉnʉjeero yʉre tii nemoña! —ĩiupi.
Bojoca paʉ cʉ̃ja ca nea poo nʉnʉa dooro ĩari, wãtĩ yerire o biro ĩi tuti cõa wieneupi: —“Wãtĩ, wedeti, tʉoti, ca biigʉ yoari méé witi waagʉja. Pʉati cʉ̃re ñaajãa nʉcã nemoticãña,” mʉre yʉ ĩi —ĩiupi.
To cõrora wãtĩ pea bʉaro acaro bui, ñañaropʉ cʉ̃re tii wẽe yaye cõa cũu cojo, witicoaupi. Cʉ̃ pea ca dia waaricʉre biropʉ biicã cũmu waaupi. To biri paʉ, “Dia yaicoami,” ĩiupa.
Jesús pea cʉ̃ amopʉ ñee, cʉ̃re tʉ̃a wãmʉoupi. To biro cʉ̃ ca tiirora, cʉ̃ pea wãmʉ nʉcãcoaupi.
Jiro Jesús wiipʉ cʉ̃ ca jãa waaro, cʉ̃ buerã pea cʉ̃ja wado niirã, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi jãiñaupa: —¿Ñee tiirã jãa pea wãtĩre jãa cõa wiene majitijapari? —ĩiupa.
To biro cʉ̃ja ca ĩiro Jesús pea: —Wãtĩa anija ʉnoa, betirique mena juu buecãripʉ wado cõa wienericaro ca witirã niima —ĩiupi cʉ̃ buerãre.
Cʉ̃ ca bii yaipere pʉati cʉ̃ ca wederique
Too ca niiricarã waarã, Galilea yepa pee ametʉa waaupa. Jesús pea jĩcʉ̃ ʉnora cʉ̃ja ca majiro bootiupi,

cʉ̃ buerãre buema ĩigʉ. O biro cʉ̃jare ĩi wedeupi: —Yʉ, Ca Nii Majuropeegʉ Macʉ̃re, aperãpʉre yʉre tiicojorucuma. Cʉ̃ja pea yʉre jĩa cõacãrucuma. To biro cʉ̃ja ca tii cõacãmijata cãare, itia rʉmʉ jiro yʉ cati tuacoarucu ñucã —cʉ̃jare ĩiupi.
Cʉ̃ja pea to biro cʉ̃ ca ĩirijere tʉo majitiupa. Cʉ̃re jãiñarʉgarã cãa uwi jañuupa.
¿Ñiru pee cʉ̃ niiti, ca nii majuropeegʉ?
Too ca waaricarã, Capernaúm macãpʉ eaupa. Wiipʉ niigʉ, o biro cʉ̃jare ĩi jãiñaupi Jesús cʉ̃ buerãre: —Maapʉ doorã, ¿ñeere mʉja wede pai nʉnʉa doojãri? —ĩiupi.
Cʉ̃ja pea maapʉ doorã, “¿Ñiru pee cʉ̃ niiti, ca nii majuropeegʉ?” ca ameri ĩi nʉnʉa dooricarã niiri, wedetiupa.

To biro cʉ̃ja ca biiro ĩa, Jesús pea ea nuu waa, cʉ̃ buerã pʉa amo peti, dʉpore pʉaga penituaro ca niirãre jʉo cojo, o biro ĩiupi: —Jĩcʉ̃, ca nii majuropeegʉ ca niirʉga tʉgoeñagʉ ʉnoa, niipetirã jiro macʉ̃pʉ nii, niipetirãre pade coteri majʉ nii, cʉ̃ biijato —cʉ̃jare ĩiupi.
To biro ĩi, jĩcʉ̃ wimagʉre cʉ̃ja watoa cʉ̃re nʉcõ, cʉ̃re ami apa, o biro cʉ̃jare ĩiupi Jesús:
—Yʉre ca tʉo nʉnʉjeegʉ, jĩcʉ̃ ani wimagʉre
biro ca biigʉre ca ñeegʉa, yʉrena ñeegʉ tiimi. Ñucã yʉre ca ñeegʉa, yʉre ca tiicojoricʉre ñeegʉ tiimi —ĩiupi.
Manire ca junatigʉa mani mena macʉ̃ niimi
Juan pea o biro ĩiupi Jesús're: —Buegʉ, jĩcʉ̃ mʉ wãme mena ĩicãri, wãtĩare ca cõa wiene niigʉre jãa ĩajãwʉ. Jãa pea mani mena macʉ̃ méé cʉ̃ ca niiro macã, “Teere tiiticãña,” cʉ̃re jãa ĩijãwʉ —ĩiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉupi Jesús: —Camotaaticãña. Jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera yʉ wãme mena ĩicãri, ca ĩa ñaaña manirije ca tii bau niigʉa, ñañaro yʉre ĩi majitimi.
Manire ca junatigʉa, mani mena pee ca niigʉ niimi.
No ca boorã, mʉja Cristo yaarã ca niirãre, oco bapa ʉnoacãra mʉjare ca tĩarã, to biro cʉ̃ja ca tiirique jʉori, cʉ̃ja yee ca niipere bʉarucuma.
Ñañaro ca bii buiyeerije
”No ca boogʉ, anija mena macʉ̃ wãmaacã yʉre ca tʉo nʉnʉjee jʉo doogʉre ñañarije cʉ̃ ca tiiro ca tiigʉra, ʉ̃tãga pairica mena cʉ̃ amʉtuture jia tuuri, dia pairi yaapʉ cõañua cõacãjata, añucãbocu.
Mʉ amo ñañarije mʉ ca tiiro to ca tiijata, tii amore paa taa cõacãña. Amo dʉcara caticõa niirica tabepʉre mʉ ca earo añujañu.
Pʉa amo menapʉra ñañaro bii yairica tabe pecame jĩcãti ʉno peera yaticoa, becoa cãa diacoa, cʉ̃ja ca biitiri tabepʉre mʉ ca waaborica tabe ʉnorena.
Mʉ dʉpo ñañarije mʉ ca tiiro to ca tiijata, paa taa cõacãña. Dʉpo manigʉra to birora caticõa niirica tabepʉre mʉ ca earo, añujañu.
Pʉa dʉpo menapʉra ñañaro bii yairica tabe pecame jĩcãti ʉno peera yaticoa, becoa cãa diacoa, cʉ̃ja ca biitiri tabepʉre mʉ ca waaborica tabe ʉnorena.

Ñucã mʉ capega ñañarije mʉ ca tiiro to ca tiijata, jade wee amiri cõacãña. Jĩcãga capega manigʉra Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca doti niiri tabepʉre mʉ ca earo, añujañu. Pʉa capega menapʉra ñañaro bii yairica tabe:

content.text: pecame cãa yatiti, ca biiri tabepʉre mʉ ca cõa joe ecopa tabe ʉnorena.”

content: ”Niipetirã, ñañaro tamʉo ametʉari jiro bʉaro jañuri ca tʉgoeña bayirã nii nʉnʉa waarucuma.

Moa añurije nii. To biro bii pacaro to ca oca yerijãacoajata, ¿do biro pee tiicãri ñucã, ca ocarije ca nii earo mʉja tii majibogajati? Mʉja majuropeera moare biro niiña. Niipetirã mena añuro niirique cʉti niiña —ĩiupi Jesús.

footnotes.text: 9.37Arameo wederique menara wimagʉ to ca ĩijata, pade coteri majʉ cãare to biri wãmera ĩicã. 1Ti 4.12; Mt 17.4.

9.49 “Niipetirãpʉra peca ca ʉ̃ʉrije mena moa tuu jãaricaro biro tii ecorumuma. Ñucã waibʉcʉrã jĩari tiicojo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorique cõrora moa mena tuu jãa ecorucu. Ca wetapʉre jeerʉgarã peca mena joe abo, ñucã moa, baariquere ca poaro tii, ca boatiro tii, ca tiirore birora tii ecorucuma. Ñucã moare to ca ĩijata, majirique maquẽrena ĩicãro ĩi. Tee majiriquera Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca boorore biro mani yaarã mena añuro mani ca niiro ca tiirije nii.” Mc 9.33-37.
